race.comment: GRAVEL ROAD (2) made nice progress last start when second-up from a spell, boxing on bravely to finish less than a length from the winner in a similar race to this. Can improve at the third run back from a spell. Looks the testing material with the help of a nice gate. HELLFIRE HENRY (4) showed pace and battled on okay to hold third recently over this distance at Orange. Takes on a better race but drops 3.5kgs. Each-way shout. BANG ON TIME (3) was a month between runs when safely held over this distance at Illawarra Grange last start. Better for that outing but will need a touch of luck from an awkward draw. AM I DREAMING (1) raced wide for the trip and dropped out of contention when resuming over 1300m at Newcastle last time out. Better for that run and can improve sharply with a bit more luck in running. DAMASCUS CALLING (7) prefers the sting out of the ground but from the inside gate can sneak into the frame.
